# Apex Conclave

> Apex Conclave is a student-led events and competitions brand in India. It creates platforms for high school and college students to compete, collaborate and showcase their abilities through competitions, conferences and experiences. Diplovia 2026, a virtual Model United Nations, is its first and currently only event; new formats are coming soon.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what Apex Conclave is, its event verticals, the featured event, team and partnerships
- [Event Verticals](/verticals): Diplomacy & MUNs (active, Diplovia 2026); new formats coming soon
- [Events](/events): every event, upcoming and past
- [Diplovia 2026](/events/diplovia-2026): virtual MUN on 22 and 23 November 2026 with five committees (UNSC, WHO, UNHRC, UNGA, Historical Crisis Committee); fees, allotment and FAQ
- [About](/about): mission, the people it brings together, team and how events are run
- [Partners](/partners): sponsorships, college partnerships, competition challenges, judges and mentors, campus communities
- [FAQ](/faq) and [Contact](/contact)
